question: Within each DSL, how does the archived solution_opus48 fused artifact compare with the current fused artifact when both are remeasured contemporaneously?

scope.input_distribution: torch.rand seed 0, with nn.Linear-style uniform weight and bias
scope.interpretation: end-to-end steady-state performance of the frozen Model.forward artifact; source differences in casts, weight layouts, caches, intermediate dtypes, tiles, pipelines, softmaxes, and autotuners are intentionally retained
exclusions: no claim that either artifact is a latent DSL optimum
no code-generation-only claim because each archived/current pair is a different program
the single-input correctness diagnostic is not a substitute for the full frozen fused-v2 4x64 validation gate

performance_protocol.block_unit: one fresh serialized process per subject within a randomized complete block
performance_protocol.timing: CUDA events around exactly Model.forward(x); L2 flush and synchronization occur before the start event

correctness_diagnostic.reference: fp32 torch matmul + fp32 bias + exact erf GELU + fp32 softmax on the performance input
required: all elements pass the historical elementwise tolerance
correctness_diagnostic.qualification: This one-input diagnostic protects the timing comparison from an obviously invalid execution. It is explicitly not a full fused-v2 gate acceptance claim.

inference.paired_contrast: within-block current_ms / archived_ms for each DSL
inference.confidence_interval: exact central order-statistic interval [x4,x12] for n=15, achieved coverage 0.96484375
inference.paired_test: exact two-sided sign test of within-block ratios around 1
inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the two preregistered within-DSL contrasts
inference.directional_claim_rule: all 15 paired blocks valid, exact interval strictly on one side of 1, and Holm-adjusted sign-test p < 0.05
inference.tie_rule: ratio exactly 1 is omitted from the sign test but remains in the interval and estimator
